mapper.sql: cv.id, cv.app_id, cv.open_id, cv.nickname, cv.avatar_url, cv.last_message, cv.last_message_at, cv.last_customer_message_at, cv.message_count, cv.unread_count, cv.user_id, cv.owner, cv.assigned_at, cv.hosted_by_ai, cv.contact_id, cv.lead_id, cv.create_time, cv.update_time, cfg.account_name, cfg.account_type, c.name AS contact_name, COALESCE(l.lead_name, l.full_name) AS lead_name
FROM crm_wechat_mp_conversation cv LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_config cfg ON cfg.app_id = cv.app_id LEFT JOIN crm_contact c ON c.contact_id = cv.contact_id LEFT JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = cv.lead_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id, open_id, nickname, avatar_url, last_message, last_message_at, last_customer_message_at, message_count, unread_count, user_id, owner, assigned_at, hosted_by_ai, contact_id, lead_id, create_time, update_time FROM crm_wechat_mp_conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wechat_mp_conversation ( app_id, open_id, nickname, avatar_url, last_message, last_message_at, last_customer_message_at, message_count, unread_count, contact_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{openId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{lastCustomerMessageAt}, COALESCE(#{messageCount}, 1), COALESCE(#{unreadCount}, 1), #{contactId}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (app_id, open_id) DO UPDATE SET nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.nickname), avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.avatar_url), last_message = EXCLUDED.last_message, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, last_customer_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_customer_message_at, message_count = crm_wechat_mp_conversation.message_count + 1, unread_count = crm_wechat_mp_conversation.unread_count + 1, contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.contact_id), update_time = now()

INSERT INTO crm_wechat_mp_conversation ( app_id, open_id, nickname, avatar_url, last_message, last_message_at, message_count, unread_count, contact_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{openId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, 0, 0, #{contactId}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (app_id, open_id) DO UPDATE SET nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.nickname), avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.avatar_url), last_message = EXCLUDED.last_message, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wechat_mp_conversation.contact_id), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, owner = #{owner}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_conversation SET user_id = NULL, owner = NULL, assigned_at = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_conversation SET hosted_by_ai = #{hostedByAi,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_conversation SET nickname = COALESCE(#{nickname}, nickname), avatar_url = COALESCE(#{avatarUrl}, avatar_url), update_time = now() WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND open_id = #{openId}
